actions.summary: Student-facing generative AI (chatbots, AI tutors) barred in pre-K through 8th grade for the 2026-27 school year; teachers may still use AI for planning and admin. High school continues with up to ~50,000 students in five approved gen-AI pilots plus two mandatory 45-minute AI-literacy modules per year.
actions.notes: Announced 2026-09-02 by Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Chancellor Kamar Samuels, who called it 'the broadest generative AI moratorium in the nation'. One-year term, to be reassessed. Exceptions for assistive tech (IEP/ELL) and computer-based assessments. Paired with screen-time caps (none PK-2, 30 min/day 3-5, 45 min/day 6-8) and AI features being disabled in 38 existing software contracts. Enrollment figure is approximate.
